title: Brain Teasers & Fun Riddles
subject: Logic & Word Puzzles
description: Clever, witty, and amusing riddles that require quick lateral thinking and observation.

questions.question: What has keys, but no locks; with space, but no room; and you can enter, but cannot go in?
questions.fact: A computer keyboard has keys, a space bar, and an Enter key!

questions.question: What gets wetter the more it dries?
questions.fact: As a towel dries your hands and body, it soaks up water and becomes wetter!

questions.question: I have branches, but no fruit, trunk, or leaves. What am I?
questions.fact: Banks have branch offices all over towns, but no leaves or wood!

questions.question: What has hands, but cannot clap or hold anything?
questions.fact: A clock has an hour hand and a minute hand ticking around its face!

questions.question: What can you catch, but never throw?
questions.fact: You can catch a cold when you are sick, but you can't toss it through the air!

questions.question: What goes up, but never comes back down?
questions.fact: Every birthday your age climbs higher, but it never goes backward!

questions.question: What has one eye, but cannot see a single thing?
questions.fact: Needles have eyes for thread, potatoes have eye buds, and hurricanes have quiet center eyes!

questions.question: What belongs to you, but everyone else uses it much more than you do?
questions.fact: Other people call out your name constantly when speaking to you!

questions.question: What has many teeth, but cannot chew any food?
questions.fact: Combs and zippers have rows of teeth to smooth hair or fasten coats, but no mouth!

questions.question: What can travel around the entire world while staying in one tiny corner?
questions.fact: A postage stamp stays tucked in the corner of an envelope as letters travel across continents!

questions.question: If you drop a white hat into the Red Sea, what does it become?
questions.fact: The Red Sea is blue water, so dropping any hat into it just makes it wet!

questions.question: What has a thumb and four fingers, but is not alive?
questions.fact: A winter glove or mitten has five finger slots to keep your hand warm!

questions.question: What runs all around a backyard without ever moving?
questions.fact: A wooden or chain-link fence encloses the whole yard while standing perfectly still!

questions.question: What has legs, but doesn't walk at all?
questions.fact: Tables and chairs stand steadily on four legs, but cannot take a step!

questions.question: The more you take out of me, the bigger I become. What am I?
questions.fact: When you dig dirt out of a hole in the ground, the hole expands larger and larger!

questions.question: What begins with T, finishes with T, and has T (tea) inside it?
questions.fact: A 'Teapot' starts with T, ends with T, and holds delicious hot tea inside!
